```{python}
#| label: fig-process-sti
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "CMOS process, step 1—shallow trench isolation: (a) a hard mask is grown and patterned by photolithography, (b) the isolation trenches are etched anisotropically into the silicon, and (c) the trenches are filled with oxide and the surface is planarized."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pyutil import process as pr

fig, axs = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(6.5, 5.4))

ax = axs[0]
pr.wafer(ax)
pr.hard_mask(ax, openings=pr.STI_X)
pr.setup(ax, '(a) hard mask grown and patterned', ymax=5.4)

ax = axs[1]
pr.wafer(ax, trenches=pr.STI_X)
pr.hard_mask(ax, openings=pr.STI_X)
pr.setup(ax, '(b) anisotropic etch of the isolation trenches', ymax=5.4)

ax = axs[2]
pr.wafer(ax, trenches=pr.STI_X)
pr.sti(ax)
pr.setup(ax, '(c) trenches filled with oxide, hard mask removed', ymax=5.4)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
